jobs.title: Senior Financial Analyst
jobs.description:
JLL supports the Whole You, personally and professionally.
  
  
Our people at JLL are shaping the future of real estate for a better world by combining world class services, advisory and technology to our clients. We are committed to hiring the best, most talented people in our industry; and we support them through professional growth, flexibility, and personalized benefits to manage life in and outside of work. Whether you’ve got deep experience in commercial real estate, skilled trades, and technology, or you’re looking to apply your relevant experience to a new industry, we empower you to shape a brighter way forward so you can thrive professionally and personally.
  
  
**Job Summary:**  
We are seeking an experienced Senior Financial Analyst to join our Financial & Property Management Consultancy team. The ideal candidate will possess strong expertise in developing complex master community and building operating expense and service charge models, including service charge apportionment, lifecycle costing analysis, and reserve fund assessment. This role demands exceptional presentation skills, the ability to manage projects and client reporting, and a proactive approach to supporting the line manager in developing innovative, market-leading solutions that enhance real estate performance and optimisation.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities:**  
**Project Execution:**  
Develop complex master community and property service charge models in line with RICS guidelines and operational requirements, ensuring accuracy and efficiency in calculating service charges for multiple asset classes within developments.
  
Develop service charge apportionment methodologies as per the best market practices, considering factors such as property size, tenancy, usage, and common areas allocation.
  
Collaborate with external parties to review, assess, and periodically update service rate cards to reflect market trends, changes in service scope, or new services introduced by facilities management companies.
  
Interpret development master plans and designs, encompassing architectural and engineering drawings, for the purpose of establishing services to estimate operating expenses and transform these into service charge regimes.
  
Use excellent presentation skills to effectively communicate complex financial concepts, including service charge apportionment, service charge recovery, and the implications of void costs, to clients and stakeholders.
  
Develop lifecycle costing models for building and community assets, forecasting replacement, renewal, and major maintenance costs over the asset life based on asset registers, useful life, condition, inflation, and escalation assumptions.
  
Develop reserve fund models and assessments, including reserve fund contribution requirements and funding strategies, in line with RICS guidelines and applicable local regulations, to ensure adequate funding for future capital expenditure.
  
Integrate lifecycle costing and reserve fund contributions into service charge budgets and apportionment, and conduct periodic reviews of reserve fund adequacy, shortfalls, and scenario or sensitivity analysis.
  
Present lifecycle costing and reserve fund findings and recommendations to clients and stakeholders, supporting long-term capital planning and decision-making.
  
Conduct in-depth analysis of real estate operating expenses, comparing trends, and benchmarking results against industry standards across the GCC region.
  
Manage client financial reporting requirements, including the preparation of financial statements, budgets, forecasts, and variance analysis, ensuring timely and accurate delivery of reports.
  
Create interactive dashboards and reports for C-suite executives, presenting key financial metrics, performance analysis, key cost and revenue drivers, and strategic recommendations.
  
  
**Project Management:**  
Manage and execute project deliverables within established timelines.
  
Interpret and evaluate the requirements of Requests for Proposal (RFPs) and collaborate with internal cross-functional teams/departments to develop Technical and Commercial proposals.
  
Ensure timely delivery of project deliverables and compliance with client requirements.
  
Continuously monitor project progress against risk, timelines and deliverables, adjusting plans and resources to ensure successful delivery.
  
  
**Client Management and Business Development:**  
Travel to the GCC region, whenever required, to attend client meetings, workshops and presentations.
  
Build and foster strong client relationships to establish trust and understanding to provide tailored operational financial solutions.
  
Identify and pursue business development opportunities to drive the growth of the Financial & Property Management Consultancy business including generating and qualifying leads and contributing to the preparation and submission of compelling new business proposals.
  
  
**Education:**  
Bachelor’s or master’s degree in finance, accounting, real estate, or a related field. A professional certification (CA, ACCA, CMA, CPA, RICS, etc.) is preferred.
  
  
**Experience & Skills:**  
3–5 years of relevant experience in financial analysis, service charge, or property and asset management consultancy, within the KSA or UAE real estate market.
  
Proven experience in developing complex master community and building service charge models.
  
In-depth knowledge of service charge apportionment methodologies.
  
Proven experience in lifecycle costing and reserve fund modeling and assessment for building and community assets.
  
Strong understanding of real estate financial reporting, including the preparation of financial statements, budgeting, forecasting, and variance analysis.
  
Proficiency in financial modeling and analysis software (e.g., Excel, Power BI, etc.).
  
Excellent presentation and communication skills, with the ability to convey complex financial concepts to diverse audiences.
  
Strate
